title: Refit
description: Refit is a REST library for .NET that turns REST API definitions into type-safe interfaces. Instead of manually building HttpClient requests, you define an interface and Refit generates the implementation.

data.text: Refit is a type-safe REST client for .NET. You define an interface with methods decorated by HTTP attributes, and Refit automatically generates the implementation using HttpClient under the hood.

data.content: Create an interface for a JSONPlaceholder API.

terms.definition: The compiler checks method signatures and return types, reducing runtime errors.

data.title: DI Integration
data.text: Register Refit interfaces in the DI container with services.AddRefitClient<IYourApi>().ConfigureHttpClient(c => c.BaseAddress = ...).

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Refit turns interfaces into REST clients
HTTP attributes map methods to endpoints
data.takeaway: Refit is the fastest way to build a type-safe API client in .NET.

data.title: Exercise: Build a GitHub Client
data.description: Create a Refit interface for the GitHub API.
steps: Define an IGitHubApi interface with methods for GetUser(string username) and GetRepos(string username)
Use RestService.For or AddRefitClient in DI
Call GetUser for a known GitHub user and print their name and public repos count
data.expectedOutcome: The app fetches and displays real GitHub user data with minimal boilerplate.
